arxiv-2106-10677.title: Bounds on systoles and homotopy complexity Thanks: Supported by ISF-Moked grant 2095/15 and by ERC advanced grant 101052954
arxiv-2106-10677.creator: Tsachik Gelander and Paul Vollrath
arxiv-2106-10677.description: Abstract . The main purpose of this note is to prove a lower bound on the systole of compact arithmetic manifolds in terms of the volume. The proof relies on Prasad’s volume formula. For the special case of arithmetic hyperbolic manifolds the same bound was established earlier in [ B20 ] .

arxiv-2107-12788.title: On the data persistency of replicated erasure codes in distributed storage systems
arxiv-2107-12788.creator: Roy Friedman, Rafał Kapelko, Karol Marchwicki
arxiv-2107-12788.description: Abstract This paper studies the fundamental problem of data persistency for a general family of redundancy schemes in distributed storage systems, called replicated erasure codes. Namely, we analyze two strategies of replicated erasure codes distribution: random and symmetric . For both strategies we derive closed analytical and asymptotic formulas for expected data persistency despite nodes failure . 1 Introduction 1.

Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purpose
arxiv-2204-05681.creator: Antonio Paolillo, Matteo Saveriano
arxiv-2204-05681.description: Abstract This work presents the dual benefit of integrating imitation learning techniques, based on the dynamical systems formalism, with the visual servoing paradigm. On the one hand, dynamical systems allow to program additional skills without explicitly coding them in the visual servoing law, but leveraging few demonstrations of the full desired behavior.

arxiv-2303-14043.title: Two problems on the distribution of Carmichael’s lambda function
arxiv-2303-14043.creator: Paul Pollack
arxiv-2303-14043.description: Abstract . Let λ ⁡ ( n ) \lambda(n) denote the exponent of the multiplicative group modulo n n . We show that when q q is odd, each coprime residue class modulo q q is hit equally often by λ ⁡ ( n ) \lambda(n) as n n varies.

arxiv-2308-12370.title: AdVerb: Visually Guided Audio Dereverberation
arxiv-2308-12370.creator: Sanjoy Chowdhury Sreyan Ghosh Subhrajyoti Dasgupta, Anton Ratnarajah Utkarsh Tyagi Dinesh Manocha
arxiv-2308-12370.description: Abstract We present AdVerb, a novel audio-visual dereverberation framework that uses visual cues in addition to the reverberant sound to estimate clean audio. Although audio-only dereverberation is a well-studied problem, our approach incorporates the complementary visual modality to perform audio dereverberation.

arxiv-2310-17424.title: Modified scattering of small data solutions to the Vlasov–Poisson system with a trapping potential
arxiv-2310-17424.creator: Léo Bigorgne, Anibal Velozo Ruiz, Renato Velozo Ruiz
arxiv-2310-17424.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study small data solutions to the Vlasov–Poisson system with the simplest external potential, for which unstable trapping holds for the associated Hamiltonian flow. First, we provide a new proof of global existence for small data solutions to the Vlasov–Poisson system with the trapping potential − | x | 2 2 \frac{-|x|^{2}}{2} in dimension two.

arxiv-2407-01576.title: The Future of Aerial Communications: A Survey of IRS-Enhanced UAV Communication Technologies
arxiv-2407-01576.creator: Zina Chkirbene 1 , Ala Gouissem 2 , Ridha Hamila 1 , Devrim Unal 3
arxiv-2407-01576.description: Abstract The advent of Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces (IRS) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is setting a new benchmark in the field of wireless communications. IRS, with their groundbreaking ability to manipulate electromagnetic waves, have opened avenues for substantial enhancements in signal quality, network efficiency, and spectral usage.

arxiv-2408-16489.title: Anomalous Doppler effect in superfluid and supersolid atomic gases
arxiv-2408-16489.creator: Tomasz Zawiślak, Marija Šindik, Sandro Stringari, Alessio Recati
arxiv-2408-16489.description: Abstract By employing the formalism of hydrodynamics, we derive novel analytic predictions for the Doppler effect in superfluids with broken Galilean invariance and hosting persistent currents at zero temperature. We consider two scenarios: when Galilean invariance is broken explicitly (by external potentials) and spontaneously, as it happens in a supersolid.

arxiv-2502-14530.title: Projectivity of Moduli Spaces in the Higher-Rank DT/PT Correspondence
arxiv-2502-14530.creator: Mihai Pavel, Tuomas Tajakka
arxiv-2502-14530.description: Abstract . We study projectivity of moduli spaces on the DT/PT wall crossing in Bridgeland and polynomial stability on a smooth, projective threefold. First, we construct a globally generated line bundle on the moduli stack of higher-rank PT-semistable objects and analyze the extent to which it separates points.

pmc-10610881.title: Non-Polio Enterovirus Surveillance in the Ural Federal District and Western Siberia, 2022: Is There a Need for a Vaccine?
pmc-10610881.creator: Tarek M. Itani, Vladislav I. Chalapa, Vasilii N. Slautin, Roman O. Bykov, Bolat S. Imangaliev, Polina K. Starikova, Aleksandr G. Sergeev, Aleksandr V. Semenov
pmc-10610881.description: Human non-polio enteroviruses (NPEVs) are the etiological agents involved in most cases of hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD), herpangina and aseptic meningitis. Information on the epidemiology profiles of NPEV in the Ural Federal District and Western Siberia is very limited, with no published data available.

pmc-10672755.title: Genetic and Phenotypic Virulence Potential of Non-O1/Non-O139 Vibrio cholerae Isolated from German Retail Seafood
pmc-10672755.creator: Quantao Zhang, Thomas Alter, Eckhard Strauch, Jens Andre Hammerl, Keike Schwartz, Maria Borowiak, Carlus Deneke, Susanne Fleischmann, Richard D Hayward
pmc-10672755.description: Non-O1 and non-O139 Vibrio cholerae (NOVC) can cause gastrointestinal infections in humans. Contaminated food, especially seafood, is an important source of human infections. In this study, the virulence potential of 63 NOVC strains isolated from retail seafood were characterized at the genotypic and phenotypic levels.

pmc-11428100.title: Using co-design to identify intervention components to address unhealthy dietary and activity behaviours in New Zealand South Asians
pmc-11428100.creator: Sherly Parackal, Sumera Saeed Akhtar, Sivamanoj Yadav, Rachel Brown

pmc-11431951.title: Open versus Minimally Invasive Partial Nephrectomy: Trends and Outcomes from a Wide National Population-Based Database
pmc-11431951.creator: Antonio Franco, Riccardo Lombardo, Francesco Ditonno, Eugenio Bologna, Leslie Claire Licari, Omar Nabulsi, Darren Ioos, Giacomo Gallo, Giorgia Tema, Antonio Cicione, Antonio Nacchia, Andrea Tubaro, Cosimo De Nunzio, Edward E Cherullo, Riccardo Autorino, Frank Friedersdorff
pmc-11431951.description: Objectives: To investigate temporal trends and overall complication rates among open partial nephrectomy (OPN) and minimally invasive partial nephrectomy (MIPN), including the impact of social determinants of health (SDOH) on postoperative outcomes. Methods: Patients who underwent OPN or MIPN between 2011 and 2021 were retrospectively analyzed by using PearlDiver-Mariner, an all-payer insurance claims database.

pmc-11439357.title: Genetic Testing Technology Assisting in the Diagnosis and Treatment of Multiple Suppurative Arthritis and Extensive Migratory Skin and Soft Tissue Infections Caused by Disseminated Staphylococcus aureus Disease: A Case Report and Review
pmc-11439357.creator: Xiaoyan Hong, Yangrong Huang, Wei Lin, Yi Zhang, Jianyun Lin, Shengguo Zhang, Fengquan Cai, Jie Chen
pmc-11439357.description: Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) infection is readily disseminated, yet the multiple septic arthritis and extensive migratory skin and soft tissue infections it causes are uncommon and challenging to treat. The infection can be life-threatening, with a mortality rate of 15–31%. Early, targeted antibiotic therapy is critical to improve prognosis.

pmc-11462344.title: An open-source combined atomic force microscope and optical microscope for mechanobiology studies
pmc-11462344.creator: Daniel Delgado, Sarah Desroches, Gia Kang, Yousef Aldabii, Andrew R Harris
pmc-11462344.description: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) has become the gold standard tool for measuring mechanical properties of biological samples including proteins, single cells and tissues. However, investment in this specialized equipment and gaining expertise in its operation are significant obstacles for non-experts looking to adopt this technique.

pmc-11822605.title: Characterising the extent and nature of digital food and beverage marketing in Singapore: a descriptive study
pmc-11822605.creator: Xin Hui Chua, Clare Whitton, Stefanie Vandevijvere, Bridget Kelly, Rob M van Dam, Salome A Rebello
pmc-11822605.description: Objective: To characterise the nature of digital food and beverage advertising in Singapore. Setting:Food and beverage advertisements within twenty clicks on the top twelve non-food websites and all posts on the Facebook and Instagram pages of fifteen major food companies in Singapore were sampled from 1 January to 30 June 2018.

pmc-12404048.title: Genotypic variations and clinical implications of JEV-associated peripheral nerve injury: a commentary on multicenter findings from high-endemic regions
pmc-12404048.creator: Liangping Zhang, Lei Pan, Rongqi Cao
pmc-12404048.description: We read with great interest the recent article by Wang et al. on peripheral nerve injury (PNI) associated with Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) infection in high-endemic regions of China. The study provides important insights into the significant relationship between JEV infection and PNI, particularly highlighting clinical manifestations such as acute flaccid paralysis and respiratory muscle paralysis.

pmc-12681728.title: A clinical algorithm to identify people with the glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase p.Val68Met variant at risk for diabetes undertreatment
pmc-12681728.creator: Yash Pershad, Joseph H Breeyear, Robert W Corty, Jonathan D Mosley, VA Million Veteran Program, Lawrence S Phillips, Ayush Giri, Dan M Roden, Todd L Edwards, Alexander G Bick
pmc-12681728.description: PurposeTo develop an algorithm using routine clinical laboratory measurements to identify people at risk for systematic underestimation of glycated hemoglobin because of p.Val68Met glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency.MethodsWe analyzed 122,307 participants of self-identified Black race across 4 large cohorts with blood glucose, glycated hemoglobin, and red cell distribution width measurements from a single blood draw.

pmc-13094116.title: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic potential of tryptophan metabolism in gut-brain signaling transduction: a narrative review
pmc-13094116.creator: Jiuba Zhang, Yanan Zhou, Xi Mei, Shuai Yan, Jing Mao, Yu Li, Zhenhua Bian, Lin Li, De Ji, Tulin Lu, Juxiang Chen, Lianlin Su
pmc-13094116.description: As an essential amino acid, tryptophan (Trp) serves as a pivotal mediator in gut-brain axis (GBA) communication through three primary metabolic pathways: kynurenine (Kyn), indole, and serotonin (5-HT), which together regulate neuroimmune and neuroendocrine homeostasis via the vagus and spinal afferent nerves, circulatory system, and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis.

pmc-13250510.title: Crotonylation impedes c-Myc oncogenic activity
pmc-13250510.creator: Nicholas J. Wallbillich, Peng Liao, Rashmi Srivastava, Jia Fan, Shelya X. Zeng, Hua Lu
pmc-13250510.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SignificanceOnly a handful of posttranslational modifications have been reported for c-Myc, one of the key oncoproteins which is overexpressed in an estimated 70% of cancers and responsible for regulating many essential facets of tumorigenesis and therapy resistance. Our study provides evidence for c-Myc crotonylation and identifies two key lysine residues which are responsible for crotonylation induced loss of c-Myc transcriptional activity.

pmc-13421448.title: Exploring the effect of higher loading of short carbon fibers on mechanical and physico - mechanical characterization of polyamide66 and polytetrafluroethylene blend composites
pmc-13421448.creator: M P Sandeep, B M Rudresh, M K Prasanna Kumar, M R Praveen Kumar, B V Lingesh, N Channa Keshava Naik, Addisu Frinjo Emma
pmc-13421448.description: The influence of increased short carbon fiber (SCF) content on the mechanical properties of polyamide-66/polytetrafluoroethylene (PA66/PTFE) blend composites was examined. An 80 wt% PA66 and 20 wt% PTFE blend served as the composite matrix. The potential of SCF as a reinforcement phase with higher loading (10, 20 and 30 wt%) on these blend composites was studied.

pmc-13477322.title: Association Between Optimal Revascularization for Chronic Total Occlusion and Long‐Term Outcomes in Patients With Heart Failure With or Without Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-13477322.creator: Yanjun Song, Zhangyu Lin, Jining He, Rui Fu, Kefei Dou
pmc-13477322.description: BackgroundThe relationship between optimal revascularization for chronic total occlusion (CTO) lesions and long‐term clinical outcomes in patients with heart failure with or without type 2 diabetes (T2D) remains unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the association between optimal or nonoptimal CTO percutaneous coronary intervention (CTO‐PCI) and long‐term adverse clinical outcomes in patients with heart failure with or without T2D.

uslaw-usc-t26-s3112.title: 26 U.S.C. § 3112 — Instrumentalities of the United States
uslaw-usc-t26-s3112.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s3112.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 21 (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); Subchapter B (Tax On Employers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any other provision of law (whether enacted before or after the enactment of this section) which grants to any instrumentality of the United States an exemption from taxation, such instrumentality shall not be exempt from the tax.
